description: Validate complete logging field ownership before dependent writes (REQ-030; AC-R030-01, AC-R030-02, AC-R030-03). Engineering definition with a typed contract and deterministic tests; no user-facing feature, writer, migration or live-service change. The field-to-contract matrix is docs/specs/LOGGING_FIELD_CONTRACT.md with its typed half src/data/refinement-logging-contract.ts: the 16 logging moments of the accepted reference (eded158cfd928d382c9a9409e2c372270312741d; LOGGING-FIELDS.md row 1 covers anchor and other lift) each naming schema, validator, writer, identity, null/zero/update meaning, draft and History/readback owner, and every existing and proposed measurement, load, effort and note field with its status, migration and owning task. check-01 holds the schemas in src/state/schemas.ts to the matrix (null versus zero, categorical effort never the legacy 1-10 numbers, mood distinct); check-02 binds every named source to a real export and the generated types, checks the specification states the same facts, rehearses every existing moment through the app's own clients and readers over an in-memory PostgREST transcribed from the migrations (src/test/logging-contract-double.ts), shows why categorical block effort (MIG-A) and per-movement timed partials/loads (MIG-B) need migrations, proves the proposed identities from the blocks' real outcomes, and checks that both drafts are isolated (TASK-031 lands them; applying them anywhere is the owner's LIVE-PRE-1). Explicit non-gallery disposition. Every declared case must execute and pass; the other cases in src/state/schemas.test.ts run as undeclared extras.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-030 --check check-01 -- npx vitest run src/state/schemas.test.ts --passWithNoTests=false
